system.description: With the Superior Sign of the Haywain, the Sidereal calls the attention of a lesser elemental dragon in its role as a Celestial censor; the sign also makes the dragon aware of the situation in which the Sidereal finds herself. The dragon arrives via the fastest possible means, and may or may not bring along a retinue of Celestial lions, thunderbirds or huraka. All censors have such a retinue available at short notice, even if none appear immediately. This Resplendency calls the Bureau of Heaven's aid, and constitutes an admission that the Bureau of Destiny cannot handle a situation alone. Censors don't enjoy having their influence called upon lightly: should the dragon judge the call unnecessary, he may bring the Sidereal up on whatever charges he can think of, the least of which will be wasting his time. Sidereals have died rather than call for Celestial intervention—some situations are so politically sensitive that training a new Sidereal causes less trouble for the Bureau of Destiny than dealing with the Bureau of Heaven's full scrutiny.
